findings.title: Do not timestamp replayed translation data as newly observed
findings.evidence: checkpoint.js:109-128 replays journal key/data and advances every clock after the first to current time. The collector stamps market/global components from those current clock calls, losing the original observation age.
findings.impact: Component source-age validation can accept stale cached translations in a resumed refresh. Existing default two-hour job limit bounds but does not correct the timestamp misstatement.
findings.requested_correction: Persist and reuse actual read observation timestamps or conservatively age components from the original job start. Add a resumed-foreign stale-cache regression. No production release until corrected and independently rechecked.
